info.title: MatchZy Auto Tournament API
info.description: API for managing CS2 tournament servers with secure RCON control

servers.description: API server (from API_BASE_URL, FRONTEND_BASE_URL, or localhost)

matchzyServerToken.name: X-MatchZy-Token
matchzyServerToken.description: Server-to-API authentication (webhooks, reports, demo uploads). Send `X-MatchZy-Token: <token>`.

pluginVersion.description: MatchZy Enhanced version reported by the server (from server_configured).

hostname.description: CS2 server hostname (from hostname convar, reported by MatchZy Enhanced).

lastSeen.description: Unix timestamp of last event received from this server (heartbeat).

persistentConfigSent.description: Unix timestamp when MAT last sent persistent MatchZy config via RCON.

cs2RequiredVersion.description: If set, the server reported a required CS2 update (Steam required_version).

cs2UpdatePhase.description: Best-effort phase reported by MatchZy Enhanced ('available' when update is detected, 'shutdown' right before quitting).

cs2UpdateRequiredAt.description: Unix timestamp when the update-required state was last reported.

Automatically allocates available servers to ready matches and loads them via RCON. Updates tournament status to 'in_progress'.

200.description: Tournament started successfully with match allocation results

400.description: Tournament not ready or no available servers

get.description: Returns the number of servers currently available for match allocation

post.summary: Restart tournament matches and reallocate servers
post.description: Runs css_restart on all servers with loaded/live matches, resets matches to ready status, then reallocates servers. Useful for restarting stuck matches.

200.description: Tournament restarted successfully with allocation results

400.description: Tournament not ready or restart failed

post.description: Drops all tables and reinitializes the database schema with default data (maps, map pools). This resets the database to its initial state as if starting fresh. USE WITH CAUTION!
Deletes all data from a specific table

post.summary: Reset simulation state while preserving core configuration (DEV ONLY)
post.description: Clears all matches, match events, map results, player match stats, and rating history so you can restart simulations from a clean slate, while preserving servers, teams, maps, map pools, and the current tournament configuration (name, type, maps, teams, settings). Player records are kept, but their current ELO and match counts are reset based on their starting values.

Creates a new shuffle tournament with dynamic team balancing. Shuffle tournaments are individual player competitions where teams are automatically balanced and reshuffled each round based on ELO ratings.
